root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: City label is wrong on city-change days where accommodation city differs from day.city_name. Transport info is invisible. Meal assignment is unnecessarily rigid.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex raised 7 findings. 5 are real bugs incorporated into the spec (F1: cross-meal persistence requires client-side option copy; F2: mobile.js must be added to scope; F3: data-origin-slot-id needed on meal cards; F4: _buildMealsCandidateGroup must be explicitly specified; F5: day-picker listener duplication must be avoided). 1 is out-of-scope (F6: state.transportation.segments deep-render — user requirement explicitly scopes to day-level timestamps). 1 is incorporated as AC constraint (F7: CSS rewrite must preserve functional state selectors).

findings.issue: Cross-meal drop will persist invalid selected_option_id if option not in target slot options[]
findings.proposed_fix: In requestSelectMutation, before setting selected_option_id, copy source option into target slot's options[] if not already present
findings.rationale: Without this fix, selection breaks after reload. Applied as Technical Hints implementation note and AC3 persistence criterion.

findings.issue: Mobile _markTapTargets uses strict slotId equality, misses meals-any
findings.proposed_fix: Add web/js/mobile.js to scope; update _markTapTargets to use _isMealCompatible for meals-any
findings.rationale: Mobile workflow entirely broken without this. Added mobile.js to affected files.

findings.issue: Meal cards need data-origin-slot-id for persistence and debugging
findings.proposed_fix: Add data-origin-slot-id attribute set to source slot (breakfast/lunch/dinner) on meal cards in _buildMealsCandidateGroup
findings.rationale: Needed for cross-meal option copy (F1 fix) to know the source option's slot.

findings.proposed_fix: Specify dedicated _buildMealsCandidateGroup with de-dup, multi-slot selection check, all-skipped empty state
findings.rationale: Without this spec, dev has no guidance on edge cases. Added to Technical Hints.

findings.issue: Calling _populateDayPicker inside renderAll() accumulates duplicate change event listeners
findings.proposed_fix: Split into _renderDayPickerOptions() (called from renderAll) and _wireDayPicker() (called once from init using sel.onchange = ...)
findings.rationale: Real runtime bug — each renderAll call (which happens on every mutation) would add another listener. Applied in Technical Hints and M3 spec.

findings.issue: M4 should use state.transportation.segments for richer detail (from_city_name, mode, etc.)
findings.proposed_fix: Render from state.transportation.segments.find(s => s.depart_day === activeDay || s.arrive_day === activeDay)
findings.rationale: User requirement explicitly says 'Read from day.departure_ts, day.arrival_ts, day.day_type. Display-only (read existing schema fields, no new API calls).' Segment-level display is out of user-need scope. Logged in out_of_scope_observations.

findings.issue: Full CSS rewrite risks breaking functional state selectors (.card-candidate, [data-drop-active], etc.)
findings.proposed_fix: Add explicit AC that all functional CSS selectors are preserved
findings.rationale: Applied as AC9 and listed in Edge Cases section.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: 5 blockers/majors applied to spec; 1 observation logged to out_of_scope_observations; 1 major applied as AC9 constraint.
